items.title: R-22-92: Menaul Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan Approval Resolution
items.description: The signed City Council resolution approves the Menaul Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan, finds its redevelopment actions will prevent blight, and incorporates the plan into the City Code of Resolutions after public meetings, commission recommendation, and a public hearing.
items.provenance_status: official City Legistar matter record and enacted attachment reviewed; signed original verified visually
processing_notes: Original official enacted resolution preserved without modification.
Rendered signature page confirms 9-0 Council adoption on May 1, 2023 and mayoral approval on May 18, 2023.
The separately attached adopted plan is already retained as canonical candidate src-3f2dca78dd97e88d; it is not being archived again.

items.title: MRCOG 2030 Metropolitan Transportation Plan: Pedestrian Element
items.description: The 2030 regional plan's pedestrian element establishes the Pedestrian Composite Index, identifies activity and deterrent factors, maps priority areas and missing sidewalks, summarizes policy and accessibility needs, and frames pedestrian projects, grants, and multimodal implementation.
processing_notes: Original MRCOG PDF preserved without modification.
Twelve-page historical 2030 MTP chapter reviewed from the official MTP Archive.
